about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Get to know my engineering journey, technical philosophy, and active tech radar
about.description:
I am a Fullstack Web Developer with hands-on experience across the full software development lifecycle — from designing backend architectures and building RESTful APIs, to crafting responsive frontend interfaces and deploying applications to the cloud.

My expertise spans enterprise backend systems (Java Spring Boot, ASP.NET Core, NestJS), modern frontend frameworks (React, Next.js, Angular), and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure). I have a strong passion for real-time communication systems, microservices architecture, and building software that scales.

Currently, I'm focused on enterprise ERP development, optimizing database performance, and leveraging AI-assisted tools to improve development workflows.

bio.heading: Crafting Scalable, Resilient Software with Precision
bio.p1: I am a Fullstack Web Developer with hands-on experience across the entire software development lifecycle — from designing mission-critical backend architectures and optimizing relational databases to crafting high-performance, fluid user interfaces.
bio.p2: My engineering philosophy centers on simplicity, clean domain boundaries, and measurable performance. Whether tuning complex SQL Server stored procedures for enterprise ERP systems or designing reactive real-time microservices, I build software that thrives in production.
bio.quote: "Code is read far more often than it is written. Build for clarity, optimize for scale, deploy with discipline."
